units.source_text: 纸商连瞧也不瞧艺人一眼，逐个数起棋盘上的棋子来，他下得更加谨慎了。

en.t: The paper merchant did not even glance at the entertainers; he counted the pieces on the board one by one and played even more cautiously.

units.source_text: 姑娘们把鼓和三弦琴拾掇好，放在屋角上，然后开始在象棋盘上玩五子棋。

en.t: The girls put away the drum and the shamisen, set them in the corner of the room, and then began playing five-in-a-row on the shogi board.

units.source_text: 我本是赢家，这会儿却输了。

en.t: I had been the one winning, but now I lost.

units.source_text: 纸商还一味央求说：“怎么样，再下一盘，再下一盘吧。”

en.t: The paper merchant kept pleading, "How about it? One more game, just one more game."
